Method of Attack: Targets security software to prevent detection and removal
Disables Windows Defender services and processes
Adds DisableAntiSpyware Windows policy to disable Windows Defender
Disables Windows Security notifications and real-time protection
Uses Registry settings and Set-MpPreference PowerShell commands to disable Windows Defender preferences
Configures Image File Execution Options Registry key to set debugger for security processes causing them to fail launching
Impacted Systems: Windows 10 machines with Windows Defender/Microsoft Defender installed
Indicators of Compromise: Termination of MsMpEng.exe, MSASCuiL.exe, MSASCui.exe processes
Registry keys under SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Real-Time Protection
PowerShell commands using Set-MpPreference with various Disable* parameters
Debugger process named 'kakugulykau' configured for security software processes
Affected processes: MBAMService, SAVService, SavService.exe, ALMon.exe, SophosFS.exe, ALsvc.exe, Clean.exe, SAVAdminService.exe
